workspace_purpose: Real-data citation verification for the cap-sat rebuttal (NeurIPS 2026 submission 19389, forum 3XJrmmUpc2). Reference claims transcribed verbatim from 实际rebuttal/cap-sat/OPENREVIEW_REBUTTAL_FULL.md.
trusted_proxy_justification: This machine routes all egress through its own local relay at 127.0.0.1:7890 (system-wide HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy, see scutil --proxy). Per docs/citation-verification.md section 6, strict DNS is unusable in relay-only environments; trusted_proxy is enabled with an explicit allowlist restricted to the fixed authority routes (arXiv, OpenReview, DOI/Crossref, Semantic Scholar secondary) plus dl.acm.org, which is the DOI landing redirect target for REF-SIMONSPECK.
